inicio.kicker: Course · 8 lessons · prompt, context and role
inicio.titulo: Stop hunting for the perfect prompt: define the role
inicio.lead: First, we wrote the request word by word. Then we learned to give context. Now the AI works like someone on the team, and the skill that counts is managing. In eight lessons you see what changed in each era, build an agent's role sheet, give it a goal it can check, train it in rounds, and keep an eye on the cost.

cta2.t: Go straight to the role sheet

inicio.capa_alt: Dark office at night: a gray-haired manager watches humanoid robots working at separate desks.
inicio.aulas_sub: From the three eras to the role sheet, from the measurable goal to training in rounds and cost. Each lesson has a diagram, a template to copy, practice with a "done when" and a commented quiz.

itens: People who already use ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and feel like they keep rewriting requests.
People who took a prompt course and want to understand what still matters with today's models.
People who have started using agents and want to delegate the way they would to a person.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Cut from an old prompt what the model already does on its own.
Write an agent's role sheet, with a goal you can measure.
Train the agent in rounds until you have a written standard procedure.
Pick the right model for each task and keep track of the bill.
In the chat (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini), with a project of fixed instructions: this is the course's main path.
In the terminal, with Claude Code or Codex, for those who already use it: lessons 3, 4 and 6 also show this path.
Nei Maldaner, from INEMA.CLUB: 40 years in technology, from programmer to company founder.
When the text says "I" or "in my case," it is him telling how he works with AI agents today.
